title: Arrow of Acid

sources.title: Arrow of Acid
markers: * Deals {{InfoBlob|Weapon Damage}} and explodes in a spray of acid, dealing an additional {{DamageText|2d4|Acid|drs=t}} damage.

summary: Weapon damage plus 2d4 Acid. DC 12 Dexterity negates the Acid damage. Creates a 7 ft-radius Acid surface that reduces Armour Class by 2 while a creature stands in it. The shared arrow rules describe damage as applying to the target rather than nearby creatures.

fields.Activation: Action. Fire from a ranged weapon and consume one arrow. Range 60 ft.
fields.Effect: Weapon damage plus 2d4 Acid. DC 12 Dexterity negates the Acid damage. Creates a 7 ft-radius Acid surface that reduces Armour Class by 2 while a creature stands in it. The shared arrow rules describe damage as applying to the target rather than nearby creatures.
fields.Restrictions: Special arrows cannot be used with off-hand ranged attacks.
fields.Crafting: Special arrows are obtained from loot or vendors.
fields.Creative use: Place the surface where allies can follow up against reduced AC.
fields.Base value: 10 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Surface: The Acid surface has no timed expiration.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 activation, effects and linked rules.
